heading.title: First Division · Part I · Suits Relating to Accounts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
By a principal against his agent for movable property received by the latter and not accounted for.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the account is, during the continuance of the agency, demanded and refused or, where no such demand is made, when the agency terminates.
